name: Austria
contextBlurb: Austria regulates stablecoins through the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA). Fiat-referenced stablecoins are permitted when issued as e-money tokens by authorised credit institutions or electronic money institutions, with 1:1 reserve, redemption, disclosure, custody and AML obligations. Austria's Financial Market Authority is the national competent authority for crypto-asset service providers and token issuers under the EU framework.

legislation.title: Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA)
legislation.summary: EU-wide framework for asset-referenced tokens and e-money tokens, including licensing, reserve, redemption, governance, white paper and supervisory requirements.

stablecoinMeta.summaryEn: Austria follows MiCA. Stablecoin issuance and use are legal with restrictions: EMT and ART issuers need the relevant EU authorisation, compliant reserves, redemption rights, disclosures and AML controls. MiCA passporting applies across the EU once authorised.
stablecoinMeta.classificationNote: Single-fiat stablecoins are generally e-money tokens under MiCA; basket-backed stablecoins are asset-referenced tokens.

regulators.name: Austrian Financial Market Authority
regulators.role: National competent authority for MiCA authorisations and supervision in Austria.
